name: Pero Sirin
source:
…A half-woman, half-bird stole Ivan’s love, and he now gives chase into the Forest — a place full of mysterious paths and whispered secrets. There, he must make new friends or foes, uncover their hidden truths, and, most importantly, discover his own — eternal immortality.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3994560/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
……一个半女人半鸟偷走了伊万的爱，他现在追逐到森林——一个充满神秘路径和低声秘密的地方。在那里，他必须结交新朋友或敌人，揭开他们隐藏的真相，最重要的是，发现他自己的——永恒的不朽。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3994560/]Steam[/url]]
